verdicts.reason: A: the headline runs almost to both edges (about 28px margins). The green circle now sits behind the can and the logo, which the original kept separate. There is a large dead gap between the can and the headline, the subtitle is jammed about 20px above the CTA, and the peach circle has shrunk to a token corner blob. Still, the subtitle wraps evenly and the stack reads cleanly. B has the same edge-hugging headline and the same green circle behind the can. Its subtitle wraps badly, with a long first line running close to the edges over a short second line. The subtitle and CTA are crowded together and sit on top of the peach circle, which makes the bottom feel heavier and more cluttered than A.
